methodCrossed: 交叉滚子轴承：内外圈刚性；内圈相对外圈的五个位移（两个径向、轴向、两个倾斜）一起解；滚子正反交替，每个滚子沿长度切片，线接触按 Palmgren 公式（两接触串联），存储能是位移的凸函数，求极小后用牛顿法精修；滚子可以部分或全部卸载。刚度取柔度矩阵的逆。接触应力按赫兹线接触，沟道是锥面。关节水平轴、只用一个交叉滚子支承时，悬臂重力按力矩 W·x 计入。

Crossed roller bearing: rigid rings; the inner ring’s five displacements (two radial, axial, two tilts) solved together; rollers alternating, each sliced along its length, line contact by Palmgren’s law (two contacts in series); the stored energy is convex in the displacements, minimised and polished by Newton steps; rollers may unload. Stiffness is the inverse of the compliance. Contact stress by Hertz line contact on the conical raceways. A joint with a horizontal axis held by one crossed roller bearing takes the overhung weight as the moment W·x.
methodFlex: 柔性轴承：内圈按凸轮形状强制变形；外圈按薄圆环（曲梁，不伸长的弯曲模态加整体伸缩，闭式解）受钢球接触力和柔轮啮合区载荷弯曲；钢球按赫兹点接触（未变形沟道曲率），由余能最小求出各球载荷并满足外圈力平衡；保持架位置在一个球距内取 8 个。沟道表面弯曲应力：内圈随凸轮转、不交变；外圈每转两次交变，取各位置范围的一半为应力幅。截面按沟底壁厚、全宽矩形；不含柔轮与齿、离心力。

Flexible bearing: the inner ring forced to the cam’s shape; the outer ring a thin ring (curved beam: inextensional bending modes plus uniform stretch, closed form) bent by the ball contacts and the flexspline’s meshing zones; Hertz point contacts (raceway curvatures as made), ball loads from minimum complementary energy with the outer ring in balance; 8 cage positions over one ball pitch. Raceway bending stress: steady in the inner ring (it turns with the cam), alternating twice per turn in the outer ring (amplitude half the range). Section: full width, wall at the groove bottom; the flexspline, its teeth and centrifugal force are not modelled.
methodThin: 薄壁轴承：钢球作为自由体，内圈五个方向的位移和每个钢球的位置一起解（能量最小）；四点接触每个钢球最多四个接触点。套圈按刚性计算。

ratingsNote: 额定载荷和寿命按国家标准计算，标准正文录入前显示“未知”。
Load ratings and life follow the national standards and show “unknown” until the standard texts are entered.
ribHint: 不填：垂直于挡边面，沿滚子轴线
Blank: square to the rib face, along the roller axis
rowSpacingHint: 两个轴承宽度中心之间的距离
Between the width centres of the two bearings
savedLocal: 已自动保存在这台电脑的浏览器里
scHint: 按峰值工况；竖线为当前调整量；软件不推荐“最佳值”
At the peak case; the line is the current setting; no "best" value is suggested
sigAAllow: Outer ring allowable alternating stress amplitude
skHint_camshaft: 贴入一圈内的力（转角, Fx, Fy，可加 Fz），可来自问渠凸轮或缝纫机软件。
Paste the force round one turn (angle, Fx, Fy, optionally Fz), e.g. from WenQuest Cam or the sewing-machine software.
skHint_gearbox: 由齿轮参数和功率算啮合力，再按两轴承跨距分到本轴承；可填几个工况（功率、转速、时间占比）。
Gear data and power give the mesh forces, shared between the two bearings; give one or more cases (power, speed, share of time).
skHint_generic: 直接填轴承上的径向力、轴向力、力矩和转速。
Enter the radial force, axial force, moment and speed on the bearing.
skHint_hub: 车轮载荷、转弯侧向加速度和滚动半径，分到内外两排；外圈转。自动算直行和左右转弯三个工况。
Wheel load, cornering acceleration and rolling radius shared between the two rows; the outer ring turns. Straight running and both turns are worked.
skHint_joint: 关节来回摆动：以静强度为主。竖直轴时，重量在力臂上产生倾覆力矩。
The joint swings back and forth: static strength governs. With a vertical axis the weight on its lever tilts the bearings.
skHint_motor: 转子重量、不平衡量和带拉力分到两轴承；不平衡随轴转，每 10° 算一次。
Rotor weight, unbalance and belt pull shared between the bearings; the unbalance turns with the shaft and is worked every 10°.
skHint_spindle: 主轴前端的切削力，悬伸在前轴承 A 之前；轴向切削力由前轴承承受。
Cutting force at the spindle nose, overhanging in front of the front bearing A; the front bearing takes the axial force.
sliceTitle: 最重载滚子：沿长度的接触应力
Heaviest roller: contact stress along its length
spanL: 两轴承跨距 L（A 到 B）
spanTwoHint: 应用场景为“通用”时填；其他场景用场景里的跨距 L
For the general application; the others use their span L
sweepHint: Fill in both for the curve
sweepHintThin: 预紧量曲线扫的游隙范围（µm，如 10 到 −15）；两个都填才画
The clearance or end play range swept (µm, e.g. 10 to −15); fill in both for the curve
sweepHintX: 预紧量曲线扫的径向游隙范围（如 10 到 −20 µm）；不填不画
The clearance range swept (e.g. 10 to −20 µm); blank: no curve
tarr_DB: 成对：背对背 DB（O 形）
tarr_DF: 成对：面对面 DF（X 形）
thermalHint: 填调整时温度、工作温度和三个线膨胀系数，就按工作时的游隙算各工况；都不填则不计温度，只填一部分结果为“未知”。线膨胀系数按实际材料填。

Give the setting temperature, the working temperatures and the three expansion coefficients and the cases run at the end play at work; none given: heat not taken; some given: unknown. Use the real materials’ coefficients.
thinDiagP: 对角线 +（内圈 −z 侧、外圈 +z 侧）
thinTable: 各接触点的最大值（峰值工况）
title: 项目名称
Project name
tolDemoNote: 偏差是演示用的虚构数，不是标准或推荐值。
The deviations are made up for the demo: not standard or recommended values.
tolEmpty: 填名义尺寸和上下偏差（或“从设计取名义尺寸”），点“计算”。
Fill in the sizes and deviations (or take them from the design) and press Compute.
tolHist: 径向游隙分布（蒙特卡洛，µm；竖线为目标范围）
Radial clearance (Monte Carlo, µm; lines: the target range)
tolInterf: 有过盈的可能：蒙特卡洛中游隙为负的比例 {p}（这些样本的接触角、轴向游隙不计）
Interference is possible: {p} of the samples have a negative clearance (their contact angle and axial play are not counted)
tolIntro: 由沟底直径、钢球直径、沟曲率半径的名义尺寸和上下偏差（企业填），算径向游隙、自由接触角、轴向游隙和端面凸出量的范围：极值法、统计法（正态，公差带为 ±3σ）、蒙特卡洛并排列出。

From the groove bottom diameters, ball diameter and groove radii with their deviations (yours): the range of the radial clearance, free contact angle, axial play and standout by extremes, statistics (normal, tolerance = ±3σ) and Monte Carlo, side by side.
tolNeedBall: 先在“设计校核”里打开一个球轴承
Open a ball bearing in Design first
tolNote: 蒙特卡洛 {n} 次，固定随机种子 {seed}：同样的输入得到同样的结果。
Monte Carlo {n} samples, fixed seed {seed}: the same input gives the same result.
tolOutside: 游隙落在目标范围外的比例：{p}
tolPosHint: 沟位置：沟道中心到各自基准端面的距离，算端面凸出量用（配对时）；不需要就两个都空着。偏差精确时填 0、0，空着不当 0。
Groove position: from the groove centre to the ring’s reference face, for the standout (pairs); leave both blank if not needed. An exact size is 0, 0: blanks are not taken as 0.
tolShare: 各尺寸对径向游隙的影响（方差占比）
Each size’s share of the clearance variance
tolTHint: 填了就算落在范围外的比例
Filled: the share outside is given
w0Hint: 内圈长轴处比原来的半径大 w₀（短轴处小 w₀）；企业按凸轮图纸填
The inner ring’s long axis is w₀ above its round radius (the short axis w₀ below); from your cam drawing
xHint: 在 B 外侧时大于跨距
Beyond B: more than the span
xrAlong: 最重滚子沿长度的接触应力
Contact stress along the heaviest roller
